Every example below lives in the [`examples/`](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/tree/main/examples) directory of the repository.
Open the source link to see the full Typst snippet, data and all.

::: {.gallery}

::: {.gallery-item}
```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/examples/minimal.svg"
#include "/examples/minimal.typ"
```

### Minimal scatter
Inline iris sample plotted with a single [`geom-point`](reference/geoms/geom-point.qmd) layer and continuous x/y scales.

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/minimal.typ)
:::

::: {.gallery-item}
```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/examples/multilayer.svg"
#include "/examples/multilayer.typ"
```

### Multilayer trend
Lines and points share a discrete colour mapping.
[`geom-line`](reference/geoms/geom-line.qmd) + [`geom-point`](reference/geoms/geom-point.qmd).

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/multilayer.typ)
:::

::: {.gallery-item}
```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/examples/histogram.svg"
#include "/examples/histogram.typ"
```

### Histogram
Continuous x binned with [`stat-bin`](reference/stats/stat-bin.qmd) via [`geom-histogram`](reference/geoms/geom-histogram.qmd).

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/histogram.typ)
:::

::: {.gallery-item}
```{typst}
//| output-filename: "/assets/examples/smooth.svg"
#include "/examples/smooth.typ"
```

### Smoother
Scatter plus a linear fit with a 95% confidence ribbon from [`geom-smooth`](reference/geoms/geom-smooth.qmd).

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/smooth.typ)
:::

### Simple bars

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/bar-simple.typ)
:::

### Facets
One panel per level of a discrete variable via [`facet-wrap`](reference/facets/facet-wrap.qmd).

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/facets.typ)
:::

### Themed plot
Per-element overrides with [`theme`](reference/themes/theme.qmd) on top of [`theme-minimal`](reference/themes/theme-minimal.qmd).

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/themed.typ)
:::

### Penguins
CSV-loaded dataset: flipper length vs body mass, coloured by species.

[Source](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/blob/main/examples/penguins.typ)

More snippets (bars dodged, stacked, filled, colour bars, reference lines, ribbons, shapes, text labels, coord clip) live in the [`examples/`](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/tree/main/examples) directory alongside their sources.
